title: The Episode About the Slaughter of Wazir Khan

blocks.text: Wazir Khan sees too late that his earlier crimes and Sucha Nand’s counsel have driven him into a crisis from which there is no safe concealment or easy retreat.
One proposed answer is treachery: a plan is made to slip in a thousand soldiers under false pretenses so Banda can be trapped from within once battle begins.
But the would-be deceiver is recognized at once by Banda, who exposes the scheme and shows that political deceit will not succeed where open force has already begun to fail.
